models.tenant: The branding values an email reads: names, publicHost (links only), Keycloak base URL and realm, account type, logo mark, primary color and its stored foreground, font key, sender name, reply-to, footer, support, and legal links. Under ADR 0007 one deployment serves one customer; the two entries are two sample deployments shown side by side to prove that templates follow branding, not two tenants of one deployment.
models.template: One email template with subject, preheader, heading, paragraphs, details rows, button, note, closing, and reason. Sender is genie (React Email) or keycloak (Keycloak's built-in template, unstyled: paragraphs[0], then the link, then the remaining paragraphs).
models.sampleValues: Values for the tokens in template text so previews read like real mail. Recipients are keyed by sample deployment.
models.reviewerEmail: Where Send test to me delivers.

relationships: Every template renders against any sample deployment; nothing in a template is deployment-specific

Keycloak templates are Keycloak's built-in templates (DEC-40): unstyled, printing the realm display name (the company name) only; sent through the realm SMTP settings (sender name and reply-to), which provisioning owns and Branding never writes; only to local-account deployments
The From address is the deployment MAIL_FROM (no-reply@genie.example); the tenant sets the display name and reply-to

templates.name: Invitation (brokered)
templates.trigger: An administrator adds a person in a tenant that signs in through its identity provider.
templates.subject: {inviterName} added you to {productName}
templates.preheader: Sign in with your {companyName} account to open your assigned solutions.
templates.heading: You have been added to {productName}
paragraphs: Hello {recipientName},
{inviterName} added you to {productName} at {companyName}. Sign in with your usual {companyName} account. There is no separate password.
After you sign in, you see the solutions your roles allow. If something you expect is missing, ask {inviterName}.
templates.buttonNote: If the button does not work, copy the address into your browser.
templates.reason: You receive this email because an administrator added you to {productName}.

templates.name: Invitation (local account)
templates.trigger: An administrator adds a person in a tenant with local accounts on. Keycloak sends the set-password email separately.
templates.subject: {inviterName} added you to {productName}
templates.preheader: A separate email lets you set your password.
templates.heading: You have been added to {productName}
paragraphs: Hello {recipientName},
{inviterName} added you to {productName} at {companyName}. Your account uses its own password.
A second email with the subject "Set your {companyName} password" arrives within a few minutes. Set your password from that email first, then sign in here.
templates.buttonNote: Set your password before you use this link. If the button does not work, copy the address into your browser.
templates.reason: You receive this email because an administrator added you to {productName}.

templates.name: Role granted
templates.trigger: A role is assigned to the person directly, or the person joins a group that holds a role.
templates.subject: You can now use {scopeLabel}
templates.heading: New access: {roleName}
paragraphs: Hello {recipientName},
{inviterName} granted you the role {roleName} for {scopeLabel}. It is available the next time you open {productName}.
templates.reason: You receive this email because your access in {productName} changed.

templates.name: Role removed
templates.trigger: A role is revoked from the person, or the person leaves a group that held it.
templates.subject: Your access to {scopeLabel} was removed
templates.heading: Access removed: {roleName}
paragraphs: Hello {recipientName},
{removedBy} removed the role {roleName} for {scopeLabel}. You can no longer open it.
You can still open {remainingSolutions}. If you think this is a mistake, contact {removedBy}.
templates.reason: You receive this email because your access in {productName} changed.

templates.name: Role removed (nothing left)
templates.trigger: The same event when the removed role was the person's last grant. No button: there is nothing to open.
templates.subject: Your access to {scopeLabel} was removed
templates.heading: Access removed: {roleName}
paragraphs: Hello {recipientName},
{removedBy} removed the role {roleName} for {scopeLabel}. You can no longer open it.
You have no solutions left in {productName}. Your account stays active, and you see them again when a role is granted. If you think this is a mistake, contact {removedBy}.
templates.reason: You receive this email because your access in {productName} changed.

templates.name: New-device sign-in
templates.trigger: Core emits core:session:new when a person signs in from a device not seen before.
templates.subject: New sign-in to {productName} from a new device
templates.preheader: A new session started from {deviceLabel} at {ipAddress}.
templates.heading: New sign-in from a new device
paragraphs: Hello {recipientName},
Your {productName} account was signed in from {deviceLabel} at {ipAddress} on {signedInAt}.
If this was you, no action is needed. If not, revoke the session from your account page and tell your administrator.
templates.buttonNote: If the button does not work, copy the address into your browser.
templates.reason: You receive this email because a new device signed in to your {productName} account.

templates.name: Module notification
templates.trigger: A module emits a notification event for the person and the person's email preference allows it.
templates.subject: {notificationTitle}
templates.heading: {notificationTitle}
paragraphs: Hello {recipientName},
{notificationBody}
templates.buttonNote: You need to sign in to {productName} to open the record.
templates.reason: You receive this email because {moduleName} notifications are turned on in your account preferences.

templates.name: Set password
templates.trigger: Keycloak sends it when an administrator adds a local-account person or resends the set-password email.
templates.subject: Update Your Account
templates.preheader: Your administrator has just requested that you update your {companyName} account by performing the following action(s): Update Password.
templates.heading: {companyName}
paragraphs: Your administrator has just requested that you update your {companyName} account by performing the following action(s): Update Password. Click on the link below to start this process.
This link will expire within 12 hours.
If you are unaware that your administrator has requested this, just ignore this message and nothing will be changed.

templates.name: Reset password
templates.trigger: Keycloak sends it when a local-account person uses Forgot password on the sign-in page.
templates.subject: Reset password
templates.preheader: Someone has requested to reset the credentials for your {companyName} account.
templates.heading: {companyName}
paragraphs: Someone has requested to reset the credentials for your {companyName} account. If this was you, click on the link below to reset them.
This link will expire within 30 minutes.
If you don't want to reset your credentials, just ignore this message and nothing will be changed.

templates.name: Verify email
templates.trigger: Keycloak sends it when an administrator changes a local-account person's email address.
templates.subject: Verify email
templates.preheader: Someone has created a {companyName} account with this email address.
templates.heading: {companyName}
paragraphs: Someone has created a {companyName} account with this email address. If this was you, click the link below to verify your email address.
This link will expire within 24 hours.
If you didn't create this account, just ignore this message.
